name: Zalo Bot Platform Channel
description: Official Zalo Bot Platform (bot.zapps.me) API channel for ActonOS AI agents with Markdown rich text, instant live typing indicators, rich media (photos, documents, audio), auto quote replies, multi-account gateway, and intelligent agent routing
author: ActonOS Core Team

zalo_bot_token.title: Zalo Bot Token
zalo_bot_token.description: Primary Bot Token from Zalo Bot Platform (https://bot.zapps.me). Securely stored in Hardware Vault.

default_agent.title: Default Target Agent
default_agent.description: Default ActonOS AI agent to dispatch incoming messages when no explicit @agent mention is present

parse_mode.title: Rich Text Parse Mode
parse_mode.description: Rich text format parser for outbound AI messages (markdown or html)

poll_interval_seconds.title: Polling Interval (seconds)
poll_interval_seconds.description: Time delay in seconds between consecutive getUpdates long-polling cycles

enable_typing_indicator.title: Live Typing Indicator
enable_typing_indicator.description: Automatically broadcast real-time 'Typing...' status to the user on Zalo while the AI agent generates a response

enable_reply_quote.title: Auto Quote Reply
enable_reply_quote.description: Automatically attach reply_to_message_id to link outbound responses directly to the user's prompt

accounts.title: Additional Bot Accounts (Multi-Bot)
accounts.description: Configure multiple Zalo Bot accounts for department routing, multi-brand support, or multi-tenancy

account_id.title: Account ID
account_id.description: Unique identifier for this bot instance (e.g. sales_bot, support_bot)

display_name.title: Display Name
display_name.description: Friendly label for this bot account in UI

zalo_bot_token.title: Zalo Bot Token
zalo_bot_token.description: Account-specific Zalo Bot Token (stored securely in Hardware Vault)

default_agent.title: Default Target Agent
default_agent.description: Target agent for this specific bot account
